dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline following the trailing edge, characterized by a sharp posterior indentation that becomes more pronounced towards the mid-section of the fin height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius, creating a sharply pointed terminal morphology at the fin's highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear diagonal ascent with a steep constant slope measured at approximately 42 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to maximum vertical height ratio of approximately 1.7:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple small, circular white depigmented marks or lesions scattered across the lower lateral surface; visible minor irregular notch on the trailing edge just below the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white stippling pattern distributed across the dark gray pigmentation of the lower fin and adjacent dorsal body surface.
